caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a bonnet. The exterior of the bonnet is colored purple with subtle shading to suggest curves and volume, and it includes several small rounded accents or buttons along the side. The inner lining of the bonnet is patterned with intersecting diagonal lines in shades of pale green and yellow, creating a plaid-like appearance. An attached ribbon, colored in light pink with a checkerboard or small geometric pattern, lies loosely coiled beneath the bonnet. The drawing is set against a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or decorations. The artist’s signature, "Sara Garfinkel," is located in the bottom left corner of the image.
title: Bonnet
